name: Patchbay Synth Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Sounds for the Patchbay Synth across fifteen styles: techno, acid, house, synthwave, ambient, cinematic, electro, hip-hop, dub, funk and disco, trance, chiptune, drum and bass, generative patches and effects. Many tunes use patch cables (cords) for S/H melodies, ring-modulated bells, filter wobbles, lag glides and vibrato. All levels are matched.
